name: Ransomware Response Playbook
description: Emergency response for active ransomware execution or encryption activity.

steps.name: Isolate affected asset
steps.description: Immediately cut the asset from the network.

steps.name: Page the incident commander
steps.description: Alert the IR channel; declare a major incident.

steps.name: Preserve volatile evidence
steps.description: Snapshot the incident context; image memory before power-off.

steps.name: Identify patient zero and scope
steps.description: Determine the initial access vector and every affected asset.

steps.name: Protect backups
steps.description: Verify offline/immutable backups are intact and disconnect backup networks.

steps.name: Engage legal, insurance and regulators
steps.description: Decide on notification duties and engage external responders.

steps.name: Rebuild and restore
steps.description: Rebuild from clean images, restore from verified backups and rotate credentials.
